issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing Course.addRating(stars:) but does not specify a return type. The template declares addRating(stars:) with no return value (Void), while the solution implements addRating(stars:) returning Bool. This mismatch between template and solution signatures can confuse students about whether they should return a value and may cause tests (or the reference solution) to disagree with student implementations.
issues.suggestedFix:
Choose one consistent signature for addRating(stars:) across the problem statement, template, and solution. Two options:
1) If a return value is desired: update the template and problem statement to declare addRating(stars:) -> Bool and document that it returns true when a valid rating (1-5) was appended and false otherwise. Update any tests accordingly.
2) If no return value is intended: change the solution to implement addRating(stars:) as Void (no return) and only perform the side-effect of appending valid ratings. Ensure the problem statement clarifies no return value is expected.
